provenance: Two native open-PDK MOS PCells arranged as a generic inverter; no ADC source/netlist is included. Captures terminal access geometry and the native deck facts.

tech
  format 35
  ihp-sg13g2
end

version
 version 1.0.1
 description "IHP SG13G2: Open Source rules and DRC"
 requires magic-8.3.617
end

#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Status Feb. 26, 2026: Version 1.0.0 (beta): Development release
# Status Mar. 10, 2026: Version 1.0.1 (beta): Development release
#------------------------------------------------------------------------

#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Known device types
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# device name			magic ID layer	description
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cap_cmim			mimcap		MiM cap
# cap_rfcmim					RF model for MiM cap
#
# dantenna			ndiode		ndiff to psub diode (marked device)
# dpantenna			pdiode		pdiff to nwell diode (marked device)
# schottky			schottky	Schottky diode
# isolbox			isolbox		parasitic diode model of deep nwell
#
# ptap1						substrate tie resistance
# ntap1						well tie resistance
# rsil			 	nres		Salicided n+ poly
# rppd				pres		Unsalicided p+ poly
# rhigh				xres		Unsalicided n poly
#
# npn13g2			npn		NPN W=0.07um L=0.9um
# npn13g2l			npn		NPN W=0.07um L=1.0-2.5um
# npn13g2v			npn		HVNPN W=0.12um L=1.0-5.0um
# pnpMPA			pnp
#
# sg13_hv_nmos			hvnfet		Thick-oxide nFET
# sg13_hv_pmos			hvpfet		Thick-oxide pFET
# sg13_lv_nmos			nfet		Thin-oxide nFET
# sg13_lv_pmos			pfet		Thin-oxide pFET
# nmosi				nfet		Thin-oxide nFET in deep nwell pwell
# nmosiHV			hvnfet		Thick-oxide nFET in deep nwell pwell
# nmoscl_2			hvnfetesd	Extended-drain ESD thick-oxide nFET
# nmoscl_4			hvnfetesd	Extended-drain ESD thick-oxide nFET
# scr1				hvnfetesd	Silicon-controlled rectifier
# 
# Rparasitic					Parasitic resistance, not used
# cparasitic					Parasitic capacitances, not used
#------------------------------------------------------------------------

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tile planes
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

planes
  dwell,dw
  well,w
  active,a
  poly,po
  metal1,m1
  metal2,m2
  metal3,m3
  metal4,m4
  metal5,m5
  cap1,c1
  metal6,m6
  metal7,m7
  passiv,p
  comment,c
end

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tile types
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

types
# Deep nwell
  dwell dnwell,dnw
  dwell digisub

# Wells
  well nwell,nw
  well pwell,pw
  well pblock,pblk
 -well obswell
  well pbase,npn
  well nbase,pnp
  well isolbox

# Transistors
  active nmos,ntransistor,nfet
  active pmos,ptransistor,pfet
  active hvnmos,hvntransistor,hvnfet
  active hvpmos,hvptransistor,hvpfet
 -active hvnmosesd,hvntransistoresd,hvnfetesd
 -active hvpmosesd,hvptransistoresd,hvpfetesd
  active varactor,varact,var
  active varcontact,varc
  active pvaractor,pvaract,pvar
 -active sealcont,sealc

# Diffusions
 -active difffill
  active ndiff,ndiffusion,ndif
  active pdiff,pdiffusion,pdif
  active pbasec,pbcontact,pbc
  active nemitter,nemit,ne
  active nemitterc,nemitc,necontact,nec
  active gemitterc,gemitc,gecontact,gec
  active hvnemitter,hvnemit,hvne
  active hvnemitterc,hvnemitc,hvnecontact,hvnec
  active hvndiff,hvndiffusion,hvndif
  active hvpdiff,hvpdiffusion,hvpdif
  active ndiffc,ndcontact,ndc
  active pdiffc,pdcontact,pdc
  active hvndiffc,hvndcontact,hvndc
  active hvpdiffc,hvpdcontact,hvpdc
  active psubdiff,psubstratepdiff,ppdiff,ppd,psd
  active nsubdiff,nsubstratendiff,nndiff,nnd,nsd
  active ptapdiff,ptap
  active ntapdiff,ntap
  active hvpsubdiff,hvpsubstratepdiff,hvppdiff,hvppd,hvpsd
  active hvnsubdiff,hvnsubstratendiff,hvnndiff,hvnnd,hvnsd
  active hvptapdiff,hvptap
  active hvntapdiff,hvntap
  active psubdiffcont,psubstratepcontact,psc
  active nsubdiffcont,nsubstratencontact,nsc
  active ptapdiffcont,ptapc
  active ntapdiffcont,ntapc
  active hvpsubdiffcont,hvpsubstratepcontact,hvpsc
  active hvnsubdiffcont,hvnsubstratencontact,hvnsc
  active hvptapdiffcont,hvptapc
  active hvntapdiffcont,hvntapc
 -active obsactive

# Poly
  active poly,p,polysilicon
  active polycont,pc,pcontact,polycut,polyc
 -poly obspoly
 -poly polyfill

# Resistors
  active npolyres,nres,rsil
  active ppolyres,pres,rppd
  active xpolyres,xres,rhigh
  # Used in scr1, nmoscl_2, and nmoscl_4
  active hvndiffres,hvrnd,hvrndiff
  # Used in ptapSB
  active isodiffres,risodiff,riso
  # Used in scr1
  active hvisodiffres,hvrisodiff,hvriso

# Diodes
  active pdiode,pdi
  active ndiode,ndi
  active pdiodecont,pdiodec,pdic
  active ndiodecont,ndiodec,ndic
  active schottky,sdi
  active schottkycont,schottkyc,sdic

# Metal 1
  metal1 metal1,m1,met1
  metal1 rmetal1,rm1,rmet1
  metal1 via1,m2contact,m2cut,m2c,via,v,v1
 -metal1 obsm1
 -metal1 m1fill
 -metal1 iprobe
 -metal1 diffprobe
 -metal1 sealvia1,sealv1

# Metal 2
  metal2 metal2,m2,met2
  metal2 rmetal2,rm2,rmet2
  metal2 via2,m3contact,m3cut,m3c,v2
 -metal2 obsm2
 -metal2 m2fill
 -metal2 sealvia2,sealv2

# Metal 3
  metal3 metal3,m3,met3
  metal3 rmetal3,rm3,rmet3
 -metal3 obsm3
  metal3 via3,v3
 -metal3 m3fill
 -metal3 sealvia3,sealv3

# Metal 4
  metal4 metal4,m4,met4
  metal4 rmetal4,rm4,rmet4
 -metal4 obsm4
  metal4 via4,v4
 -metal4 m4fill
 -metal4 sealvia4,sealv4

# Metal 5
  metal5 metal5,m5,met5
  metal5 rm5,rmetal5,rmet5
 -metal5 obsm5
  metal5 via5,v5
 -metal5 m5fill
 -metal5 sealvia5,sealv5

# MiM cap
  cap1 mimcap,mim,capm
  cap1 mimcapcontact,mimcapc,mimcc,capmc

# Metal 6
  metal6 metal6,m6,met6
  metal6 rm6,rmetal6,rmet6
 -metal6 obsm6
  metal6 via6,v6
 -metal6 m6fill
 -metal6 sealvia6,sealv6

# Metal 7
  metal7 metal7,m7,met7
  metal7 rm7,rmetal7,rmet7
 -metal7 obsm7
 -metal7 m7fill

# Passivation cut
 -passiv pillar,cu
 -passiv solder,sbump
 -passiv seal
  passiv glass

# Miscellaneous
  comment fillblock
  comment thruvia,tsv
  comment inductor
  comment comment

end

  allndiffcont	   allndiffcontlv,allndiffconthv

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

styles

  ndiff     ndiffusion

  pdiff     pdiffusion
  nsd       ndiff_in_nwell
  psd       pdiff_in_pwell
  ntap      ndiff_in_nwell
  ptap      pdiff_in_pwell
  nfet      ntransistor    ntransistor_stripes
  pfet      ptransistor    ptransistor_stripes
  ndc       ndiffusion     metal1  contact_X'es
  pdc       pdiffusion     metal1  contact_X'es
  nsc       ndiff_in_nwell metal1  contact_X'es
  psc       pdiff_in_pwell metal1  contact_X'es
  ntapc     ndiff_in_nwell metal1  contact_X'es
  ptapc     pdiff_in_pwell metal1  contact_X'es
  sealc     pdiff_in_pwell metal1  contact_X'es

  pnp	    nwell ntransistor_stripes
  npn	    pwell ptransistor_stripes

  hvnemitter  emitter  hvndiff_mask

  hvriso    ndiff_in_nwell pdiff_in_pwell substrate_field_implant hvndiff_mask

  hvpfetesd ptransistor    ptransistor_stripes

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Special paint/erase rules
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

compose
  compose  nfet  poly  ndiff
  compose  pfet  poly  pdiff
  compose  var   poly  nsd
  compose  pvar  poly  psd

  compose  hvnfet  poly  hvndiff
  compose  hvpfet  poly  hvpdiff

  decompose hvnfetesd poly hvndiff
  decompose hvpfetesd poly hvpdiff

  paint  ndc     nwell  pdc
  paint  nfet    nwell  pfet
  paint  ndiff   nwell  pdiff
  paint  psd     nwell  nsd
  paint  psc     nwell  nsc
  paint  ptap    nwell  ntap
  paint  ptapc   nwell  ntapc

  paint  pdc     pwell  ndc
  paint  pfet    pwell  nfet
  paint  pdiff   pwell  ndiff
  paint  nsd     pwell  psd
  paint  nsc     pwell  psc
  paint  ntap    pwell  ptap
  paint  ntapc   pwell  ptapc

  paint  m1      obsm1  m1
  paint  m2      obsm2  m2
  paint  m3      obsm3  m3
  paint  m4      obsm4  m4
  paint  m5      obsm5  m5
  paint  m6      obsm5  m6
  paint  m7      obsm5  m7

  # Seal ring contacts are not really contacts in
  # the database, so use compose rules instead.
  paint  sealc	 psd	sealc
  paint  sealv1	 m1	sealv1
  paint  sealv2	 m2	sealv2
  paint  sealv3	 m3	sealv3
  paint  sealv4	 m4	sealv4
  paint  sealv5	 m5	sealv5
  paint  sealv6	 m6	sealv6

  # To preserve keep-out areas for pattern fill,
  # do not allow comment to overwrite fillblock or inductor.
  paint  fillblock comment fillblock
  paint  inductor comment inductor

  # nwell itself is a p-implant blocker, so don't erase
  # nwell when painting pblock, even though overlap is
  # technically allowed according to the documentation.
  paint  nwell  pblock  nwell
  paint  isolbox pblock isolbox

end

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Electrical connectivity
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

connect
  *nwell,*nsd,*ntap,*hvnsd,*hvntap,dnwell,pnp,isolbox \
	 *nwell,*nsd,*ntap,*hvnsd,*hvntap,dnwell,pnp,isolbox
  pwell,*psd,*ptap,*hvpsd,*hvptap,digisub pwell,*psd,*ptap,*hvpsd,*hvptap,digisub
  # Note:  This connects butting taps even without a metal strap.
  *nsd,*hvnsd	*pdiff,*hvpdiff
  *psd,*hvpsd	*ndiff,*hvndiff
  *ntap,*hvntap	*pdiff,*hvpdiff
  *ptap,*hvptap	*ndiff,*hvndiff
  npn,pbc	npn,pbc
  pbc,*m1	pbc,*m1
  schottky,sdic	schottky,sdic
  sdic,*m1	sdic,*m1
  *m1,m1fill,iprobe,diffprobe	*m1,m1fill,iprobe,diffprobe
  *m2,m2fill	*m2,m2fill
  *m3,m3fill	*m3,m3fill
  *m4,m4fill	*m4,m4fill
  *m5,m5fill	*m5,m5fill
  *m6,m6fill	*m6,m6fill
  *m7,m7fill    *m7,m7fill
  *mimcap       *mimcap
   allnactivenonfet	allnactivenonfet
   # Resistor to isolated pwell tap
   isodiffres	*ndiff,*psd
   # Note:  This creates a short through hvndiffres resistors.
   *pdiff,*psd,*pdiode,*hvpdiff,*hvpsd *pdiff,*psd,*pdiode,*hvpdiff,*hvpsd
  *poly,allfets,polyfill	*poly,allfets,polyfill
end

include ihp-sg13g2-cifout

mzrouter

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

include ihp-sg13g2-drc

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# LEF format definitions
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

lef

# Vendor standard cells are fully contacted to nwell and substrate
# so masterslice layers for nwell/pwell are not required.

masterslice poly  GatPoly

routing m1	Metal1
routing m2	Metal2
routing m3	Metal3
routing m4	Metal4
routing m5	Metal5
routing m6	TopMetal1
routing m7	TopMetal2

cut via1	Via1
cut via2	Via2
cut via3	Via3
cut via4	Via4
cut via5	TopVia1
cut via6	TopVia2

obs obsm1	Metal1
obs obsm2	Metal2
obs obsm3	Metal3
obs obsm4	Metal4
obs obsm5	Metal5
obs obsm6	TopMetal1
obs obsm7	TopMetal2

obs obsm1,obsm2	Via1
obs obsm2,obsm3	Via2
obs obsm3,obsm4	Via3
obs obsm4,obsm5	Via4
obs obsm5,obsm6	TopVia1
obs obsm6,obsm7	TopVia2

end

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Device and Parasitic extraction
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include ihp-sg13g2-extract

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wiring tool definitions
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------

wiring
 # All wiring values are in nanometers
 scalefactor 10

 contact v2  200 m2 0 45 m3   0 45
 contact v3  200 m3 0 45 m4   0 45
 contact v4  200 m4 0 45 m5   0 45

 contact v6 1900 m6 0    m7   0

 contact pc  160  poly 70 70 m1 0 50

 contact ndc 160 ndiff 70 70 m1 0 50
 contact psc 160   psd 70 70 m1 0 50
 contact nsc 160   nsd 70 70 m1 0 50
 contact ptapc 160 ptap 70 70 m1 0 50
 contact ntapc 160 ntap 70 70 m1 0 50

end
